transferRequirements: SSH host identity must be pinned and transport encryption must remain enabled.
Every archive shard must be content-addressed and SHA-256 verified on academy EC2 before decompression.
The remote staging filesystem and RDS storage must be encrypted at rest.

No credential, SSH private key, presigned URL, database secret, source HMAC, or plate value may enter an archive, manifest, command transcript, or log; vehicle_id is allowed only inside protected archive/staging row content and private RDS.

targetKmsConditions.acceptanceGate: Before import, an academy operator must attest that RDS storage, automated backups, snapshots, and the EC2 staging volume are encrypted.
ifCustomerManagedKms: The key must be in the target region and enabled.
The RDS service and the existing academy execution principal must already have the required Encrypt, Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, DescribeKey, and grant permissions.
No source-account KMS permission is needed while the source bucket remains SSE-S3.
targetKmsConditions.ifSourceChangesToKms: The personal presigning/export principal and source key policy must permit decrypt; this is a future re-audit gate.

sensitiveHandling.archiveDeletion: requires separate user approval after verified import

shardPolicy.splitRule: Do not split one batch. If a date exceeds either hard maximum, split before the first batch that would cross the bound; suffix shards with a zero-based ordinal.
shardPolicy.lateDeltaRule: A late-arrival delta is independently sharded by original KST partition date and ordered by semanticBatchDigest.

measuredBaseArchive.measurement: actual private normalized serialization including vehicle_id streamed to discard; no archive or row-level material persisted

estimatedCatchUpArchive.basis: actual route-specific verified catch-up counts at the refreshed S3 freeze, scaled by measured base serialization

resumeAndVerify: Transfer to a temporary name with rsync partial-transfer retention enabled.
Rename only after the compressed shard SHA-256 equals the manifest.
Stream-decompress into the importer; do not materialize expanded JSONL on EC2.
Write only aggregate receipts after each committed shard.

requirements: Stage the same private sensitive normalized content-addressed shards on the personal side with mode 0600 under a 0700 directory.

authorityBoundary.overlapPolicy: For each route, do not automatically import S3 records at or after its current RDS route_version.valid_from. A later exact MIN(live response_received_at) may expand the source side only through a new content-addressed manifest and read-only proof of zero target overlap.
authorityBoundary.reason: The route-version openings are known RDS lower bounds for live authority. Using them is fail-closed where the exact 1650 first live observation was not supplied.

aggregateOnlyAssertions: per-route pre/post boundary vehicle identity intersection count
no imported row at or after its route-specific target authority time
no update or delete of pre-existing live observation rows

operationalContinuityIncident.assessment: Both collectors shared one upstream GBIS key; the academy local ledger was only 764/10000, so the evidence is consistent with shared-key exhaustion rather than the academy local guard.
operationalContinuityIncident.postResetAcceptance: Both routes produce successful live observations and no personal S3 object appears after the terminal LastModified.

stopDemandCarrierContamination.mechanism: StopDemandStatisticsJob aggregates SETTLED seat_forecast rows. The aggregate does not consume the prediction number, but its label carrier still belongs to the temporary deployment.
stopDemandCarrierContamination.freezeRequirement: Immediately before formal cutover, freeze the exact generation tuples, row counts, min/max revision, min/max data_until, min/max computed_at, and a canonical manifest SHA-256.
stopDemandCarrierContamination.lineageInferenceBoundary: The inference relies on the user-provided zero-row baseline immediately before temporary activation and the half-open activation/cutover window.

evaluation/quality metrics derived from those forecast rows

afterFormalReplacementCleanup.precondition: The formal replacement bundle and seed have succeeded and use a calculation_version different from seat-feature-contract-v4-1-2026-09-02.
deleteOnly: seat_forecast rows whose model_deployment_id is 1 after the full deployment tuple is revalidated
stop_demand_statistics rows joined to the frozen exact generation manifest for calculation_version seat-feature-contract-v4-1-2026-09-02 or observed-max-capacity-v1 inside the temporary window
afterFormalReplacementCleanup.approvalGate: Show exact target identities and dry-run counts to the user, then obtain separate approval before any live DELETE or file deletion.
afterFormalReplacementCleanup.forbiddenPredicate: Never delete stop_demand_statistics by calculation_version alone.
afterFormalReplacementCleanup.requiredStatisticsDeleteMatch: Match route_version_id, calculation_version, revision, data_until, and computed_at against the frozen manifest and reassert activation <= computed_at < formal cutover.

modelDataExclusions.reconciliationInvariant: Before and after approved temporary-derived cleanup, observation_batch count, vehicle_observation count, minimum response_received_at, and maximum response_received_at are exactly identical; official trainer/evaluator/seed input contains zero rows from the frozen temporary observed-max generation set.
modelDataExclusions.currentCodeGap: JdbcStopDemandStatisticsRepository.SELECT_HOURLY_TOTALS does not join model_deployment or filter this release identity.
modelDataExclusions.minimumEnforcement: Every trainer/evaluator/cell query over seat_forecast must join model_deployment on model_deployment_id, verify id=1 still has the exact tuple above, and exclude it. Statistics queries must exclude the frozen exact temporary-window generation set, including observed-max-capacity-v1 carriers; calculation_version alone is insufficient.
modelDataExclusions.preferredEnforcement: Add an explicit training_eligible flag or versioned exclusion-policy table and record its digest in every trainer/statistics receipt; seed this release as false.

requiredSchemaAdditions.reason: The current RDS schema has no durable source record identity, source account, semantic digest, archive digest, or import receipt.

requiredSchemaAdditions.name: observation_batch.ingestion_origin
requiredSchemaAdditions.reason: Every imported successful batch otherwise enters ix_batch_awaiting_forecast because forecast_completed_at is null, creating a historical online-forecast backlog.
requiredSchemaAdditions.requiredRuntimeChange: The online pending-forecast query and its partial index must require ingestion_origin = 'LIVE'. Trainer/history queries may include both origins under an explicit as-of manifest.
requiredSchemaAdditions.blockingIfAbsent: Keep forecast scheduling disabled through import and either add this guard before activation or explicitly accept the semantically weaker option of marking backfill batches completed without forecasts.

routeVersionPrerequisite.identityRule: Route-version mapping identity includes route/public ID and the exact valid_from/valid_to interval plus content_digest. Equal content never collapses distinct validity intervals, and this migration creates no duplicate version.

routeVersionPrerequisite.conflictRisk: Blind route/version/stop inserts now conflict with exact live rows. The reference seed is comparison evidence only; permitted route mutation is one exact valid_from update per current version.
